feature.description: Finds missing information, conflicting instructions, undefined terms, and consequential assumptions and resolves them through focused questions or explicit defaults.

contract.purpose_user_function: Surface missing data, conflicting instructions, undefined terms, and consequential assumptions as explicit open questions or defaults.
contract.valid_inputs: Normalized goal, raw request, context, existing assumptions, conflicts, undefined terms, and policy-approved defaults.
contract.expected_outputs: Assumptions and open-question lists embedded in PM intake/Requirement IR, with blocked or conditional planning where needed.
contract.state_side_effects: Persists ambiguity records and may keep downstream work conditional or rejected until a valid package can be formed.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Structural ambiguity that prevents a valid plan causes compilation/validation failure; current code does not autonomously conduct a full interactive clarification loop.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Explicit assumption/open-question generation exists; focused user questioning and conflict-resolution dialogue are not fully automated as a standalone feature.
